from my heart to yours

Happy Birthday, Anku ♡

Some feelings deserve more than a quick message.

My dearest Anku, 💗 Happy Birthday to my sweetest sister, my forever person, and one of the most precious parts of my life. I wish you could see yourself through my eyes, because then you would understand just how special you are to me. You are part of my childhood, my happiest memories, my silly stories, and so many little moments that I will carry with me wherever life takes us. I know we may not always say everything perfectly. We might argue over the smallest things, annoy each other, or sometimes forget to show how much we care. But no little fight, misunderstanding, or distance could ever erase the love I have for you. So please remember this, especially on days when I don't say it enough: I still love you more than I ever did. Thank you for being you, Anku. Thank you for all the laughter, the teasing, the memories, and the ordinary days that become special simply because you are in them. I hope we keep making memories together — the kind we will look back on years from now and smile about. Growing up may change our routines, but I hope it never makes us strangers to each other. I hope we always find time to talk, laugh, share our worries, and celebrate each other's little victories. On your birthday, I wish you a life full of genuine happiness, peaceful mornings, people who value your heart, courage for every difficult day, and beautiful opportunities that bring you closer to your dreams. I hope you always feel loved, appreciated, and proud of the person you are becoming. You don't have to be perfect or have everything figured out to deserve all the wonderful things waiting for you. And whenever life feels heavy, remember that you don't have to handle every single thing alone. I will always care about you, cheer for you, and want to see you happy. I may not always have the perfect words, but my love and good wishes for you are real. No matter how much older we get, how busy life becomes, or how many chapters we turn, you will always be my sister and a part of my heart. If I could give you one gift beyond all the birthday wishes, it would be the certainty that you are deeply loved — today, tomorrow, and in all the years still to come. Happy Birthday, Anku. I still love you more than I ever did, and I always will. 🫂💞
Forever your sibling, forever on your side ♡
